label: Identity verdict invariance across indexed histories
term: Identity verdict invariance across indexed histories
definition: Context distinguishes solo-left, solo-right and split role configurations. The bearer type may depend on context; equality never compares individuals from different contexts. VerdictInvariant is the extra pair of biconditionals preserving earlier/later identity verdicts between the matching solo role and split role. It is not a definition of local causal similarity or an automatic counterpart principle. Its applicability is OPEN.
